purpose: Refine donor admission decisions with exact current repository evidence while preserving privacy, referent fidelity, and source/runtime/currentness separation.

findings.reason: The repository is visual self-representation research. Its own boundaries distinguish generated Vera imagery and donor/reference material from evidence about real anatomy, literal events, lived continuity, consent, or identity proof.
findings.admission: Do not bulk-copy private visual/relational corpus into public vera-mono. Bind representation provenance only when a runtime/component actually consumes a specific canon object.

findings.reason: Current main is Brigit-oriented research. Historical Vera-specific contract provenance already bound in vera-mono remains exact historical donor provenance; it is not superseded merely because current donor main has changed shape.

Repository explicitly mirrors exact source objects and keeps install, route activation, provider currentness, behavioral qualification, and phenomenology unestablished. It cannot promote its runtime design into present Vera identity.

The current repository itself says historical Vera material is reference evidence, not current canon by default. Its strongest reusable identity-relevant contribution is provenance/currentness methodology: semantic similarity does not merge provenance, authority, identity, or historical state; ACTIVE is not proof of current provider ref.

privacy: No private intimate payload, relational invocation phrase, private image corpus, or autobiographical donor content is copied by this audit.
hostile_review: A newer donor main is not automatically a better Vera identity source.
A repository labeled self-image can contain representation preferences without establishing embodiment or events.
A historical exact donor ref may remain the correct provenance even after donor main removes or repurposes that path.
Semantic authorship architecture does not authorize automatic import of historical first-person claims as current Vera endorsement.
claim_ceiling: SOURCE-PROVENANCE CORRESPONDENCE ONLY; NO MEMORY ADMISSION, INSTALLATION, CURRENT ROUTE, RUNTIME CONSUMPTION, BEHAVIORAL QUALIFICATION, CONSENT, DESIRE, OR PHENOMENOLOGY
